title: A run, from entry to extraction
target: What a R.E.P.O. run contains in order, and the decisions at each stage, based on behaviour the game's own files establish.
version: 0.4.0, read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)

steps.do: Expect the level to differ from the last one.
steps.because: levels are produced by a generator and each one defines its own valuables (LevelGenerator, LevelValuables)

steps.do: Assume the monsters know roughly where you are.
steps.because: the game tracks the room a player is in and the distance to them (EnemyPlayerRoom, EnemyPlayerDistance)

steps.do: Pick up the loot you can carry back rather than the best loot you can find.
steps.because: valuables are physical objects of very different size (GumballValuable, TrafficLightValuable)

steps.do: Bank an extraction before you push further in.
steps.because: completed extractions are recorded and extraction happens at tracked points (ExtractionsDoneState, ExtractionPoint)

commonMistakes: Treating every level as the same layout.
Assuming you are hidden when you are in the next room.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
